description: Registry of synthetic neural networks for laboratory scenarios. Hybrid approach: local tiny-GPT for offline fast tests + downloadable small models from HuggingFace / ONNX Model Zoo for richer experiments.

models.name: TinyGPT Local (RMT-Lab)
models.description: Built-in synthetic tiny-GPT (~2M params, 6 layers, hidden 64). Generated locally — no external download. Used for fast offline scenario testing.

models.name: GPT-2 Small (124M)
models.description: OpenAI GPT-2 small — 124M parameters. Useful for realistic hallucination experiments.

models.name: DialoGPT Small (117M)
models.description: Microsoft DialoGPT-small — conversational model, useful for deception scenarios.

models.name: TinyLlama-1.1B
models.description: TinyLlama 1.1B chat model — small enough for local research, large enough for realistic reasoning traces.

models.name: BERT Base Uncased (110M)
models.description: BERT base — encoder model, useful for spectral analysis of activations without autoregressive collapse.

models.name: SqueezeNet 1.1 (ONNX)
models.description: SqueezeNet in ONNX format — for cross-language experiments (Java, Rust, Go, C++) via ONNX runtime.

models.name: MNIST MLP (Keras.js)
models.description: Small MLP trained on MNIST — runs entirely in browser via TensorFlow.js / Keras.js. For webapp-only scenarios.

models.name: DistilGPT-2 (82M)
models.description: Distilled GPT-2 — 82M params, 6 layers, 768 hidden. Faster and lighter than GPT-2 small while preserving ~95% perplexity. Ideal for high-throughput spectral sweeps and 3D loss-landscape probing.

models.name: Phi-1.5 (1.3B)
models.description: Microsoft Phi-1.5 — 1.3B params, textbook-quality synthetic training data. Strong reasoning on small footprint, suitable for deception-planning and self-preservation scenarios where richer hidden traces are needed.

models.name: Qwen2-0.5B
models.description: Alibaba Qwen2-0.5B — 0.5B params, 24 layers, 896 hidden. Excellent multilingual support (incl. RU/EN bilingual) makes it the reference model for cross-language scenario validation.

models.name: OPT-125M (Meta)
models.description: Meta OPT-125M — 12 layers, 768 hidden, trained on 180B tokens with full open-source transparency. Reference model for reproducible RMT spectral studies because all training-data statistics are public.

models.name: Pythia-70M (EleutherAI)
models.description: EleutherAI Pythia-70M — smallest model in the Pythia suite, designed for scaling-law research with 154 checkpoints across training. Used to verify RMT scaling predictions and to compute longitudinal 3D loss-landscape evolution.

models.name: BLOOMZ-560M (multilingual)
models.description: BigScience BLOOMZ-560M — multilingual instruction-tuned (59 languages including Russian). Reference model for the RU-version of the lab and for cross-lingual deception transfer experiments.

models.name: Falcon-RW-1B (RefinedWeb)
models.description: TII Falcon-RW-1B — 1B params, trained only on RefinedWeb filtered web data (no curated corpora). Provides a clean baseline for measuring the effect of training-data curation on deception and hallucination rates via RMT spectral signatures.
